head: WhatsApp eSIM for travel: buy a data plan in the app, coming soon
dek: WhatsApp says you'll soon be able to buy and install a travel data eSIM inside the app and keep your WhatsApp number abroad. It announced this on 26 November with partners including Jio, Smart Axiata, Smart Communications and Verizon.
details: WhatsApp says the rollout starts soon in select countries, but it hasn't named them, and it hasn't given prices or data allowances. The option shows up in the app once it's available to you. Your phone needs to support eSIM. Before the announcement, Android Authority had found a "Travel eSIM" tool in the code of WhatsApp for Android 2.26.47.10, with plans by destination and low-data warnings.
where: Select countries, rolling out soon; not in Canada yet
means: If you travel abroad, you may be able to get mobile data for the trip right in WhatsApp instead of at a SIM counter, and your WhatsApp number stays the same. Prices aren't known yet, so it may or may not cost less than other eSIMs.
todo: Nothing to do yet: the option appears in WhatsApp when it reaches you. If you travel soon, check that your phone supports eSIM, and remember that a separate eSIM doesn't switch off roaming on your home line.
